credit_transactions_sign.name: credit_transactions_sign
credit_transactions_sign.value:
case "credit_transactions"."kind"
        when 'capture' then "credit_transactions"."amount" = 0
        when 'reserve' then "credit_transactions"."amount" < 0
        when 'admin_debit' then "credit_transactions"."amount" < 0
        when 'refund_purchase' then "credit_transactions"."amount" < 0
        else "credit_transactions"."amount" > 0
      end

credit_transactions_admin_reason.name: credit_transactions_admin_reason
credit_transactions_admin_reason.value: "credit_transactions"."kind" not in ('admin_grant', 'admin_debit') or ("credit_transactions"."admin_id" is not null and coalesce(length(trim("credit_transactions"."reason")), 0) > 0)

credit_transactions_job_ref.name: credit_transactions_job_ref
credit_transactions_job_ref.value: "credit_transactions"."kind" not in ('reserve', 'capture', 'release') or "credit_transactions"."job_id" is not null
